title: Lead status and follow-up task automation
systemName: Your lead status and follow-up automation

facts: Post (Zoho CRM Automation Expert Needed | Zoho One & Workflow Optimization): simple CRM automation that updates lead statuses and creates follow-up tasks on specific conditions; make sure current workflows run without duplicate tasks or unnecessary manual steps; test everything and explain what was changed; not a CRM rebuild.

Stack named in post: Zoho CRM, Zoho One, Zoho Creator, Deluge. No Zoho adapter exists, so the deck uses the custom workbench and no vendor name or screen appears on the page. In the client's CRM this maps to a workflow rule calling a Deluge custom function.
No client contact name in the post or reviews; personalization omitted (U-006 fallback: your team).
All people, IDs, dates and counts are invented sample data.

cover.beat: You asked for a simple automation that updates lead statuses and creates follow-up tasks on set conditions, without duplicate tasks. Here is that setup, with one sample lead.

scenes.title: One workflow rule calls one custom function.
scenes.caption: When a lead goes quiet, the function checks it, updates the status and creates the follow-up task.
scenes.beat: The workflow rule runs whenever a lead is edited, and once a day for leads with no new activity. It calls one custom function. The function checks the conditions, moves {{lead.name}} from {{status.before}} to {{status.after}}, checks for an open follow-up task, creates one for {{owner.name}}, and writes what it did to the change log.
details: If an open follow-up task already exists, the function skips creating a new one and logs the skip.
Rule name: {{rule.name}}. The conditions are agreed with you before anything goes live.
